name: Davie
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Davie, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Davie, FL: Lighting of the Greens horse parade, Winter Wonderland at Flamingo Gardens, Mrs. Claus at the Old Davie School and more.
lede: Davie does Christmas Western style: a horse parade and tree lighting at the park, Mrs. Claus in a 1918 schoolhouse and a night garden of lights at Flamingo Gardens.
celebrates: The Town of Davie's Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Department hosts the Holiday Lighting of the Greens Festival at Bamford Sports Complex and Pine Island Park, where the South Florida Trail Riders lead the Jingle Bell Horse Parade before a tree lighting. The town also shows a free Christmas movie in the park. The Old Davie School Historical Museum holds Mrs. Claus' Davie Christmas, and Flamingo Gardens runs Hoffman's Chocolates Winter Wonderland with Santa's Village, plus daytime photos with Santa and The Grouch. Lakeshore Learning's Davie store hosts a free kids gift-making event.
lastyear: In 2025 the Town of Davie held its Lighting of the Greens on Saturday, December 6, from 6 to 9 pm at the Bamford Sports Complex and Pine Island Park. The South Florida Trail Riders led the Jingle Bell Horse Parade at 6 pm, followed by the tree lighting. The town's calendar listed free admission, holiday games and rides, a petting farm, a live nativity, a visit from Santa on a fire truck and pictures with Santa inside the Pine Island Fitness and Aquatic Center.
facts: Davie's Old Davie School was built in 1918 and was the first permanent school in the Everglades, at a cost of just $12,000, according to the museum. The name Davie was officially chosen in 1914, and the town incorporated for the first time in 1925 and elected the horticulturist Frank Stirling as its first mayor. The town is known for horses and rodeos, and the Lighting of the Greens begins with a horse parade.
trains: Davie does not have its own Tri-Rail station. Tri-Rail's Broward stops include Sheridan Street at 2900 Sheridan Street in Hollywood and the Fort Lauderdale Airport station at 500 Gulf Stream Way in Dania. Metrorail and Metromover run in Miami-Dade County. Close to home, Flamingo Gardens adds Rudolph's Holiday Singalong Express on select Winter Wonderland nights. For a bigger train day, the Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has over 40 historic rail cars, including the Presidential Rail Car Ferdinand Magellan and Florida East Coast Steam Locomotive #153.

kidfact: The Old Davie School was built in 1918 and was the first permanent school in the Everglades. Today it is a museum where kids can see an old classroom and write with a dip pen.
faq: Where is the Davie tree lighting?

The Holiday Lighting of the Greens Festival is at the Bamford Sports Complex and Pine Island Park, 3801 S. Pine Island Road. The South Florida Trail Riders start with the Jingle Bell Horse Parade at 6 pm, and a tree lighting follows. Call the Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Department at 954-797-1181 with questions.
Is there a Christmas light show in Davie?

Yes. Flamingo Gardens' Hoffman's Chocolates Winter Wonderland turns about 10 acres into a walk-through holiday light experience with a 35-foot Christmas tree. It is a ticketed fundraising event: ages 12 and up pay $24, ages 3 to 11 pay $17 and ages 0 to 2 are free. Parking is free.
Where can kids meet Santa in Davie?

Kids can meet Santa at Flamingo Gardens, where Santa's Village is open nightly through December 23 during Winter Wonderland, and at the garden's daytime Santa and The Grouch photos. Mrs. Claus also hosts story time at the Old Davie School Historical Museum on a Saturday morning. Each host sets its own tickets and times.
Is there a free Christmas movie in Davie?

The Town of Davie closes its free Movies in the Park series with Christmas Chronicles 2 at the Bamford Sports Complex. Gates open at 6 pm and the movie starts at 7 pm. The town says popcorn and parking are free and asks families to bring lawn chairs and blankets.
What is the Old Davie School?

The Old Davie School Historical Museum is a restored 1918 school building. The museum says it was the first permanent school in the Everglades. It hosts Mrs. Claus' Davie Christmas, where kids write letters to Santa with a dip pen and ink and hear stories read by Mrs. Claus.
